latest_cos_commentary.headline: Rockbot is a media-for-business platform (music, TV, digital signage, advertising) used by roughly 50,000 businesses including multiple multi-unit restaurant brands.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Overlaps with Genius's digital_menu_boards and loyalty_engagement lines only at the margins (in-store media/signage and advertising), not POS or payments; typically a complementary in-store experience vendor rather than a direct POS/payments rival.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: No recent funding or ownership news identified in this research pass; total disclosed funding (per aggregator estimates) remains under $10M.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Rockbot is unlikely to be a head-to-head POS/payments competitor; if encountered in an account, treat it as an in-store media/digital-signage vendor that may coexist with a Genius deployment.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Funding figures come from third-party aggregators with some disagreement between sources ($6.68M vs $6.91M reported); treat exact figures as approximate.

verification_needed: financial health beyond early-stage funding aggregator data
